name: pubspec-lens-test-driver
description: Development-only driver for the shipped pubspec-lens extension. Contributes the pubspecLens.registryUrl setting (so the configuration API accepts the fake-registry URL write) and the pubspecLens.dependencies view (so the extension's tree registration binds to a contributed view); the Extension Manifest does not project configuration or views contributions yet.

pubspecLens.registryUrl.description: Base URL of the pub-compatible package registry.
